Which outcome methods do PubChem bioassays use most often?
SELECT aid2activityoutcomemethod, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2activityoutcomemethod WHERE aid2activityoutcomemethod IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did the federal government obligate on contracts performed in Ohio in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'OH' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2023'
Which specialties have the most clinicians who graduated after 2015?
SELECT pri_spec, count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE try_cast(grd_yr AS double) > 2015 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many drug names does PubChem's drug list hold?
SELECT count(DISTINCT drug_name) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_drug_names
On net, how much electricity did New York's grid send to its neighbours in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double)) AS net_mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND data_date LIKE '%/2022'
How many patents with "battery" in the title were granted in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE patent_date LIKE '2024%' AND lower(patent_title) LIKE '%battery%'
How are hazardous waste generators split between large, small and very small quantity?
SELECT hreport_universe_record, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many short-form filings report no participants with account balances?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500_sf WHERE try_cast(sf_partcp_account_bal_cnt AS double) = 0
Which recalls covered the most vehicles?
SELECT max(mfgname) AS manufacturer, campno, max(compname) AS component, max(try_cast(potaff AS bigint)) AS vehicles FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls GROUP BY campno ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How many virtual molecules resembling known bioactive compounds does GDBChEMBL list?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdbchembl
What were the most common reasons for hospital stays in New York in 2016?
SELECT ccs_diagnosis_description, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many contract actions did NASA sign in fiscal year 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'NATIONAL AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADMINISTRATION' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2022'
Did New York or New England use more electricity at 6 p.m. on July 20, 2023?
SELECT series_id, value FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id IN ('EBA.NYIS-ALL.D.H', 'EBA.ISNE-ALL.D.H') AND period = '20230720T22'
How many Form 5500 returns covered plan years beginning in 1999?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500 WHERE substr(form_plan_year_begin_date, 1, 4) = '1999'
Which coal mines shipped the most fuel to power plants?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT coalmine_name, coalmine_state, sum(try_cast(quantity AS double)) AS tons FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Coal' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many super PACs registered for the 2024 cycle?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE cmte_tp = 'O' AND cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2024'
